items.html: It is found, then, that from the first coupling of ZA of Atzilut there shines upon Aba and Ima of Yetzira, that they should couple to give vitality to their children, ZON of Yetzira, in the aspect of nursing (Yenika), which is VAK. And from the second coupling, an illumination is drawn to Aba and Ima of Assiya, so that they should couple to give vitality to their children, ZON of Assiya, in the aspect of Ibur, three within three (Gimmel be-Gimmel).
